tagline: Know your processes. Improve them with confidence.
brief: Process discovery and improvement software for small and medium businesses. The identity should feel clear, approachable and professional - easy for non-technical teams, never intimidating.
criteria: Success: recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, avoids the magnifying-glass-over-flowchart cliche, and reads as both an F and a process flow.

concepts.name: Flow F
concepts.idea: An F drawn as a process: one path that branches into two nodes.
rationale: Reads as the letter F and as a tiny flowchart - no explanation needed
Rounded, friendly strokes suit non-technical SME teams
Holds up at 16 px and in one colour; heavier small-size cut for favicons

recommendation: Flow F - the most ownable and the clearest at small sizes, and it extends naturally into icons, diagrams and empty states.
next_steps: Roll out across the app and site
Extend into illustrations and empty states
